definitions.explanation: Used to ask for the reason or cause of something.

examples.japanese: なぜ{遅|おく}れたのですか。
なぜそう{思|おも}うのですか。
なぜそんなことを{言|い}ったのか、{今|いま}でも{分|わ}からない。
examples.english: I still don't understand why I said such a thing.

examples.japanese: なぜ{日本|にほん}に{来|き}たのかと{聞|き}かれて、{日本|にほん}の{文化|ぶんか}に{興味|きょうみ}があると{答|こた}えた。
examples.english: When asked why I came to Japan, I answered that I was interested in Japanese culture.

notes:
なぜ asks for the reason or cause behind something.

FORMALITY:
More formal than どうして. Appropriate for writing, news, and formal speech.

FORMS:
- Kanji: {何故|なぜ} (literary/formal)
- なぜか: for some reason, somehow
- なぜなら: because (used to introduce an explanation)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- なぜ〜のか: why (embedded question)
- なぜ〜かというと: the reason why... is
- なぜ〜のですか: why? (polite)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どうして: more casual, also means "how"
- なんで: colloquial, casual
